title: Acumulated Forms
description: Adding bedrock form functionality into java using the Cumulus library.
body:
# Acumulated Forms

Acumulated Forms is a library that allows developer to open Cumulus forms for java edition players! These forms were originally designed to be sent to bedrock users, but due to the new java dialogs feature, they can also be translated over quite nice to java edition too!

## How to use

See [the GitHub page](https://github.com/Novampr/AcumulatedForms) and it's README which gives a small introduction on how to use the project.
